summary.text: Bill Hamilton, listed by Ballotpedia as William Hamilton, is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 11 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An insurance agent, he previously served in the West Virginia House of Delegates from 2002 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Hamilton was born in Buckhannon, West Virginia, and attended Buckhannon-Upshur High School and Potomac State College.
His listed profession is insurance agent.
He represented House of Delegates District 45 from 2002 to 2018, then took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2018, succeeding Robert Karnes.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Natural Resources Committee and also serves on the Agriculture, Economic Development, Finance, Government Organization, Pensions and Workforce committees.
In the May 12, 2026 Republican primary, Hamilton defeated Jack Reger and Robert Karnes with 43.9 percent of the vote, and he faces Democrat Kevin Leon Carpenter in the general election.
